title: Microsoft Purview: retention based on last accessed date for SharePoint and OneDrive files (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes planned last-accessed retention from the retention controls Microsoft currently documents. Roadmap details, existing licensing and permissions, and the documented gaps are supported. The creation path stops early in the wizard, and two supporting Learn pages should be cited.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe this last-accessed retention option.

claims.claim: Learn's retention overview lists four retention-period start options.
claims.quote: When the content was created. ... When the content was last modified. ... When the content was labeled. ... When an event occurs.

claims.claim: Content creation is the default start of the existing retention period.
claims.quote: When the content was created. The default start of the retention period.

claims.claim: The last-modified start option is supported only for files in SharePoint, OneDrive and Microsoft 365 Groups locations.
claims.quote: When the content was last modified. Supported only for files in the SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 Groups locations.

claims.claim: Retention labels can start retention when content is labelled.
claims.quote: When the content was labeled. Available with retention labels, for documents in SharePoint and OneDrive, and for email items.

claims.claim: Event-based retention is another documented retention-period start option.
claims.quote: When an event occurs. Available with retention labels that are configured for event-based retention, such as when employees leave the organization or contracts expire.

claims.claim: Last accessed is not among the start options currently listed on the retention pages.
claims.quote: Searched: '"last accessed" "retention policies"'; read 'When the retention period starts' on retention and searched retention-settings for last-access and start-of-retention text; only created, modified, labelled and event options are listed.
